Singapore Police Investigate Online Comments on Nepal Floods and Air India

Singapore police have interviewed five individuals in connection with online comments made about the Nepal floods and the Air India investment. Senior Minister K Shanmugam stated that the police were investigating "shameful" racist and xenophobic remarks. The comments were made on social media platforms.
